integrity: Proof and finite checks are provided; independent validation is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact line-search PolyCDwA on the standard simplex, local to the barycenter, isotropic quadratic, exact arithmetic. The limiting rate is a sharp uniform local linear rate, not every-orbit equality. Prior general linear convergence is acknowledged.
title: An exact all-dimensional local spectrum and Lambert-W rate for vertex-cyclic away-step descent
